meaning:
1) to hang, languish, hang down, be low
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to hang low
1a2) to be low
1a3) of distress (fig.)
1a4) to languish, look weakly (of eyes)
1b) (Niphal) to be brought low, be laid low

elsewhere.note: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.
He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
“It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
